```{r export-event-training,include=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
event_model_data <- data |>
  select(Final.Narrative, Event_Group) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Final.Narrative),
    trimws(Final.Narrative) != "",
    !is.na(Event_Group),
    Event_Group != "Unknown"
  )

saveRDS(event_model_data, "event_model_data.rds")
```
```{r , include=FALSE}
library(caret)

model_data <- data |>
  select(
    Amputation_binary,
    Sector,
    Event_Group,
    Source_Group,
    State,
    EventDate
  ) |>
  na.omit()

set.seed(123)
index <- createDataPartition(
  model_data$Amputation_binary,
  p = 0.8,
  list = FALSE
)
dattrain <- model_data[index, ]
dattest <- model_data[-index, ]


prop.table(table(data$Amputation_binary))

prop.table(table(dattrain$Amputation_binary))

prop.table(table(dattest$Amputation_binary))
# Deployment optimization: 5-fold cross-validation is omitted at startup.
# Previously computed validation results remain documented in the original Rmd.
# Train only the final model required by the interactive application.
#final mod(likely)                 check***
modfin<-glm(
  Amputation_binary ~ Sector + Event_Group + Source_Group + State,
  data = dattrain,
  family = binomial
)
# Release training-only/test-only objects after fitting.
rm(model_data, dattest, index)
gc(verbose = FALSE)

```

```{r, include=FALSE}
incident_data <- data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Final.Narrative),
    nzchar(trimws(as.character(Final.Narrative)))
  ) |>
  mutate(
    CaseID = row_number(),
    Narrative = as.character(Final.Narrative)
  )
extract_incident <- function(text) {

  text <- str_to_lower(coalesce(as.character(text), ""))

  data.frame(

    # Task: What was the worker doing?
    Task = case_when(
      str_detect(text, "\\b(clean|cleaning|washing|wiping|sanitizing)\\b") ~ "Cleaning",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(repair|repairing|maintenance|fixing|servicing)\\b") ~ "Maintenance",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(loading|unloading|lifting|carrying|moving materials)\\b") ~ "Material Handling",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(installing|installation|assembling|assembly)\\b") ~ "Installation / Assembly",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(cutting|sawing|grinding|drilling)\\b") ~ "Cutting / Machining",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(driving|operating|transporting)\\b") ~ "Operation / Driving",

      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),

    # Equipment: What equipment was involved?
    Equipment = case_when(
      str_detect(text, "\\b(conveyor|conveyor belt)\\b") ~ "Conveyor",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(forklift|lift truck)\\b") ~ "Forklift",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(ladder|stepladder)\\b") ~ "Ladder",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(scaffold|scaffolding)\\b") ~ "Scaffold",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(press|stamping machine|hydraulic press)\\b") ~ "Press",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(saw|chainsaw|table saw)\\b") ~ "Saw",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(grinder|grinding machine)\\b") ~ "Grinder",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(truck|tractor|trailer)\\b") ~ "Vehicle",

      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),

    # Body part: What part was injured?
    Body_Part = case_when(
      str_detect(text, "\\b(hand|hands|finger|fingers|thumb)\\b") ~ "Hand/Finger",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(foot|feet|ankle|toe|toes)\\b") ~ "Foot/Ankle",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(arm|elbow|wrist|forearm)\\b") ~ "Arm/Wrist",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(leg|knee|thigh|shin)\\b") ~ "Leg/Knee",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(head|skull|scalp)\\b") ~ "Head",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(eye|eyes)\\b") ~ "Eye",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(back|spine|spinal)\\b") ~ "Back/Spine",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(chest|rib|ribs)\\b") ~ "Chest",

      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),

    # Environment: Where did it happen?
    Environment = case_when(
      str_detect(text, "\\b(warehouse|storage facility)\\b") ~ "Warehouse",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(construction site|jobsite)\\b") ~ "Construction Site",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(factory|manufacturing plant|production floor)\\b") ~ "Manufacturing Facility",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(roof|rooftop)\\b") ~ "Roof",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(outdoor|outside|outdoors)\\b") ~ "Outdoor",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(confined space|tank interior|manhole)\\b") ~ "Confined Space",

      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),

    # Injury mechanism: How did the injury occur?
    Injury_Mechanism = case_when(
      str_detect(text, "\\b(pulled into|pulled by|drawn into|caught in|caught between)\\b") ~
  "Caught / Drawn Into Machinery",
      str_detect(text, "\\b(caught|trapped|pinched|entangled)\\b") ~ "Caught / Trapped",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(struck|hit by|striking)\\b") ~ "Struck By",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(fell|falling|slipped|tripped)\\b") ~ "Fall / Slip / Trip",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(burned|burnt|scalded)\\b") ~ "Burn",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(cut|cutting|punctured|stabbed)\\b") ~ "Cut / Puncture",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(crushed|compressed)\\b") ~ "Crushing",

      str_detect(text, "\\b(exposed|inhaled|ingested)\\b") ~ "Exposure",
      str_detect(text, "\\b(electrical shock|electric shock|electrocuted|electrocution)\\b") ~
  "Electrical Injury",

str_detect(text, "\\b(choking|choked|strangled|suffocated)\\b") ~
  "Asphyxiation / Choking",

str_detect(text, "\\b(punched|kicked|assaulted|attacked)\\b") ~
  "Physical Assault",

str_detect(text, "\\b(splashed|sprayed)\\b") ~
  "Splash / Spray Exposure",

str_detect(text, "\\b(pulled into|pulled by|drawn into)\\b") ~
  "Caught / Drawn Into Machinery",
str_detect(text, "\\b(fell|falling|slipped|tripped|jumped off)\\b") ~
  "Fall / Slip / Trip",
str_detect(text, "\\b(rolled his ankle|rolled her ankle|twisted ankle|twisted knee|sprained)\\b") ~
  "Twist / Sprain",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),

    # Immediate cause: Observable event, not root cause
   Immediate_Cause = case_when(

  str_detect(text, "\\b(exploded|explosion|blew up)\\b") ~
    "Explosion",

  str_detect(text, "\\b(pinned|trapped|caught|entangled)\\b") ~
    "Caught / Pinned / Trapped",

  str_detect(text, "\\b(crushed|crushing|compressed)\\b") ~
    "Crushing",

  str_detect(text, "\\b(struck by|hit by|fell onto|fell on)\\b") ~
    "Struck / Impact",

  str_detect(text, "\\b(fell from|fell off|fell approximately|fell about|fell [0-9]+ feet)\\b") ~
    "Fall from height",

  str_detect(text, "\\b(slipped|slipping|tripped|stumbled|missed a rung)\\b") ~
    "Slip / Trip / Fall",

  str_detect(text, "\\b(fell|falling)\\b") ~
    "Fall - Unspecified",
  str_detect(text, "\\b(blade broke|blade shattered|grinding wheel broke)\\b") ~
  "Tool / Blade Failure",

  str_detect(text, "\\b(cut off|cut by|cut with|punctured|stepped on a nail)\\b") ~
    "Cut / Puncture",

  str_detect(text, "\\b(burn|burns|burned|burnt|scalded)\\b") ~ "Burn",

  str_detect(text, "\\b(jumped the curb|vehicle struck|car struck)\\b") ~
    "Vehicle Impact",

  TRUE ~ "Unknown"
)
)
}
extracted <- extract_incident(incident_data$Final.Narrative)
head(extracted)
incident_data <- bind_cols(incident_data, extracted)
table(incident_data$Task)
table(incident_data$Equipment)
table(incident_data$Body_Part)
table(incident_data$Environment)
table(incident_data$Injury_Mechanism)
table(incident_data$Immediate_Cause)
incident_data |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(Task, Equipment, Body_Part,
        Environment, Injury_Mechanism, Immediate_Cause),
      ~ round(mean(.x != "Unknown") * 100, 2)
    )
  )
incident_data |>
  filter(Immediate_Cause == "Unknown") |>
  select(Final.Narrative, Injury_Mechanism) |>
  slice_head(n = 20)
```

```{r event-classifier, include=FALSE}
classifier <- readRDS("event_classifier.rds")

predict_event <- function(description) {
  x <- tokens(
    description,
    remove_punct = TRUE,
    remove_numbers = TRUE
  )

  x <- tokens_tolower(x)
  x <- tokens_remove(x, stopwords("en"))
  x <- tokens_wordstem(x, language = "english")

  x <- dfm(x)
  x <- dfm_match(x, features = classifier$features)

  if (ntoken(x)[1] == 0) {
    return("Unknown")
  }

  as.character(predict(classifier$model, newdata = x))[1]
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
new_case <- reactive({
  data.frame(
    Sector = input$sector,
    Event_Group = input$event,
    Source_Group = input$source,
    State = input$state
  )
})

amputation_prob <- reactive({

  filtered <- data |>
    filter(
      (input$sector == "All" | Sector == input$sector),
      (input$event == "All" | Event_Group == input$event),
      (input$source == "All" | Source_Group == input$source),
      (input$state == "All" | State == input$state)
    ) |>
    filter(
      !is.na(Sector),
      !is.na(Event_Group),
      !is.na(Source_Group),
      !is.na(State)
    )

  if (nrow(filtered) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  probabilities <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      modfin,
      newdata = filtered,
      type = "response"
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(probabilities)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(probabilities, na.rm = TRUE)
})

historical_frequency <- reactive({
  data |>
    filter(
      input$sector == "All" | Sector == input$sector,
      input$event == "All" | Event_Group == input$event,
      input$source == "All" | Source_Group == input$source,
      input$state == "All" | State == input$state
    ) |>
    summarise(Reports = n())
})
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
    )
  )

  plot_data <- data.frame(
    Frequency = frequency,

  ggplot(
    plot_data,

})
```

## Incident Similarity Finder

Search historical OSHA severe injury reports using a written incident description.

### Prepare Text Search

```{r, include=FALSE}
incident_tokens <- tokens(
  incident_data$Narrative,
  remove_punct = TRUE,
  remove_numbers = TRUE
)

incident_tokens <- tokens_tolower(
  incident_tokens
)

incident_tokens <- tokens_remove(
  incident_tokens,
  pattern = stopwords("en")
)

incident_tokens <- tokens_wordstem(
  incident_tokens,
  language = "english"
)

incident_dfm <- dfm(incident_tokens)
# Restrict vocabulary to reduce memory on shinyapps.io.
# Use a minimum document frequency and a bounded vocabulary.
incident_dfm <- dfm_trim(incident_dfm, min_docfreq = 3, docfreq_type = "count")
incident_dfm <- dfm_keep(incident_dfm, pattern = names(topfeatures(incident_dfm, 12000)))
rm(incident_tokens)
gc(verbose = FALSE)

incident_tfidf <- dfm_tfidf(
  incident_dfm,
  scheme_tf = "count",
  scheme_df = "inverse"
)

case_matrix <- as(
  incident_tfidf,
  "dgCMatrix"
)

case_norms <- sqrt(
  Matrix::rowSums(case_matrix ^ 2)
)

idf <- log10(
  ndoc(incident_dfm) /
    pmax(docfreq(incident_dfm), 1)
)
# Search only needs sparse matrix, norms, IDF and the feature names.
rm(incident_tfidf)
gc(verbose = FALSE)
```

### Similarity Search Function

```{r, include=FALSE}
search_incidents <- function(
  query,
  top_n = 5,
  event_filter = "All"
) {

  empty_results <- incident_data[0, ] |>
    mutate(
      Similarity = numeric(0),
      EventDate = as.character(EventDate)
    ) |>
    select(
  Similarity,
  EventDate,
  State,
  Sector,
  Event_Group,
  Source_Group,
  EventTitle,
  SourceTitle,
  Amputation,
  Narrative,
  Task,
  Equipment,
  Body_Part,
  Environment,
  Injury_Mechanism,
  Immediate_Cause,
  NatureTitle,
  Nature_Group
)

  query_tokens <- tokens(
    query,
    remove_punct = TRUE,
    remove_numbers = TRUE
  )

  query_tokens <- tokens_tolower(
    query_tokens
  )

  query_tokens <- tokens_remove(
    query_tokens,
    pattern = stopwords("en")
  )

  query_tokens <- tokens_wordstem(
    query_tokens,
    language = "english"
  )

  query_dfm <- dfm(query_tokens)

  query_dfm <- dfm_match(
    query_dfm,
    features = featnames(incident_dfm)
  )

  query_matrix <- as(
    query_dfm,
    "dgCMatrix"
  )

  query_matrix <- query_matrix %*%
    Matrix::Diagonal(x = idf)

  query_norm <- sqrt(
    sum(query_matrix ^ 2)
  )

  if (!is.finite(query_norm) || query_norm == 0) {
    return(empty_results)
  }

  similarity <- as.numeric(
    case_matrix %*% Matrix::t(query_matrix)
  ) / (case_norms * query_norm)

  similarity[!is.finite(similarity)] <- 0

  # Apply event filter before ranking
  if (event_filter != "All") {

    excluded <- is.na(incident_data$Event_Group) |
      incident_data$Event_Group != event_filter

    similarity[excluded] <- 0
  }

  best <- order(
    similarity,
    decreasing = TRUE
  )

  best <- head(
    best[similarity[best] > 0],
    top_n
  )

  if (length(best) == 0) {
    return(empty_results)
  }

  incident_data[best, ] |>
    mutate(
      Similarity = round(similarity[best], 3),
      EventDate = as.character(EventDate)
    ) |>
   
      select(
  Similarity,
  EventDate,
  State,
  Sector,
  Event_Group,
  Source_Group,
  EventTitle,
  SourceTitle,
  Amputation,
  Narrative,
  Task,
  Equipment,
  Body_Part,
  Environment,
  Injury_Mechanism,
  Immediate_Cause,
  NatureTitle,
Nature_Group
)
    
}
```

### Search Historical Incidents

```{r, echo=FALSE}
textInput(
  "incident_query",
  "Describe an incident:",
  placeholder = "A worker injured his hand while cleaning machinery"
)
renderText({
  req(nzchar(trimws(input$incident_query)))

  paste(
    "AI-Predicted Event Type:",
    predict_event(input$incident_query)
  )
})
selectInput(
  "incident_event",
  "Filter by Event Type:",
  choices = c(
    "All",
    "AI Predicted",
    sort(unique(na.omit(incident_data$Event_Group)))
  ),
  selected = "All"
)

actionButton(
  "search_button",
  "Find Similar Incidents"
)

search_results <- eventReactive(
  input$search_button,
  {
    req(nzchar(trimws(input$incident_query)))

    predicted <- predict_event(input$incident_query)

    selected_filter <- input$incident_event

    if (selected_filter == "AI Predicted") {
      selected_filter <- predicted
    }

    if (selected_filter == "Unknown") {
      selected_filter <- "All"
    }

    search_incidents(
      query = input$incident_query,
      top_n = 5,
      event_filter = selected_filter
    )
  }
)


renderTable({
  results <- search_results()

  validate(
    need(
      nrow(results) > 0,
      "No matching incidents found. Try a different description or event type."
    )
  )

  results
}, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)
selectInput(
  "selected_case",
  "Select a Case for Review:",
  choices = character(0)
)

observeEvent(search_results(), {

  results <- search_results()

  choices <- if (nrow(results) > 0) {
    setNames(
      as.character(seq_len(nrow(results))),
      paste0(
        "Case ", seq_len(nrow(results)),
        " - ", results$State,
        " (", results$EventDate, ")"
      )
    )
  } else {
    character(0)
  }

  updateSelectInput(
    session,
    "selected_case",
    choices = choices,
    selected = if (length(choices) > 0) choices[1] else character(0)
  )
})

selected_incident <- reactive({
  results <- search_results()

  req(input$selected_case)

  index <- as.integer(input$selected_case)

  req(
    !is.na(index),
    index >= 1,
    index <= nrow(results)
  )

  results[index, , drop = FALSE]
})
selected_risk <- reactive({

  case <- selected_incident()
  req(nrow(case) == 1)

  probability <- tryCatch(
    as.numeric(
      predict(
        modfin,
        newdata = case,
        type = "response"
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  historical <- dattrain |>
    filter(
      Sector == case$Sector[1],
      Event_Group == case$Event_Group[1],
      Source_Group == case$Source_Group[1]
    ) |>
    summarise(
      Reports = n(),
      Rate = if (n() > 0) {
        mean(Amputation_binary == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    )

  list(
    prediction = probability,
    historical = historical
  )
})

#Selected explain
selected_explanation <- reactive({

  case <- selected_incident()
  req(nrow(case) == 1)

  tryCatch({

    terms <- predict(
      modfin,
      newdata = case,
      type = "terms"
    )

    contributions <- data.frame(
      Feature = colnames(terms),
      Log_Odds_Contribution = as.numeric(terms[1, ])
    )

    contributions |>
      mutate(
        Log_Odds_Contribution =
          round(Log_Odds_Contribution, 3)
      ) |>
      arrange(desc(abs(Log_Odds_Contribution)))

  }, error = function(e) {
    data.frame(
      Feature = character(),
      Log_Odds_Contribution = numeric()
    )
  })
})

 similar <- incident_data
```
